title: Own a pharmacy business only as an authorised owner
what: Own or control a pharmacy business only as an authorised pharmacy business owner (or under a Ministerial exemption).

sources.title: Health Practitioners Act 2004 (NT)
sources.quote: (b) exercise any control over the conduct of; a pharmacy business unless the person: (c) is an authorised pharmacy business owner; or (d) has been granted an exemption under subclause (2).
